name: Website enquiry to Google Sheets with round robin and auto-reply (The Gantry blueprint)

parameters.content:
## Website enquiry to Google Sheets, round robin, auto-reply
Blueprint by The Gantry (gantry.work).

1. Create a Google Sheet with a tab named **Leads** and these headers in row 1:
Received | Name | Company | Email | Phone | Phone as typed | Enquiry | Source | Assigned to | Assigned email | Status | Notes
2. Fill in **Settings**: company, phone, salespeople (Name <email>, comma separated), manager email, sheet link.
3. Connect Google Sheets on **Get existing leads** and **Add to Leads sheet**.
4. Connect Gmail on **Auto-reply to enquirer** and **Notify salesperson**.
5. Test with your own email, then Publish (Activate in older versions) and put the Production form URL on your website.
Whose turn it is is remembered only on runs of the published workflow.
